title: Action body
description: The runtime→protocol compliance bridge: a self-issued, near-real-time report of what scopes a performer's tool calls actually exercised during a run, checked against the job's live Mandate. Self-reported — this cannot catch a genuinely adversarial agent that simply omits a violating action, but it turns accidental scope creep into an immediately-checkable record instead of something only a human might notice later in the Delivery.

artifacts.description: Data-flow fingerprinting: a hash of what a tool call's input actually was, never the content itself — provable later in a dispute, never exposed in the log.
